appointmentDateTime.title: appointmentDateTime
appointmentDateTime.description: This is the date and time of the appointment that the user has selected. The value should be returned in the following format - M/d/yyyy, h:mm a

appointmentType.title: appointmentType
appointmentType.description: This is the type of the appointment that the user has selected. Values are In-Person and Doorstep

reason.title: reason
reason.description: This is the reason for which the patient wanted to schedule an appointment

registrationNumber.title: registrationNumber
registrationNumber.description: This is the registration number provided by the patient to the AI chatbot
